inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.generateFromControl: Generate new audio from control video
inputs.controlStays: The control video remains attached as the motion guide in every mode.
inputs.hintInject: Injected as a keyframe into the new content.
inputs.hintStart: Used as the first frame (image-to-video start).
inputs.hintKeyframe: Injected as a keyframe at this point in the timeline.
inputs.h3Extend: MiniMax H3 captures the source video's final frame and continues from it with FL2VA. The full video is not sent as a slower, loose Ref2VA reference.
inputs.extendStrengthHint: 1.0 = seamless continuation; lower gives more creative freedom. New content is appended after the source.
inputs.voiceHint: ~5s voice sample. With an active ID-LoRA, keeps the speaker's voice consistent across clips.
inputs.h3PictureHint: Use <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>… in the prompt. Max identity uses more VRAM and is slower.
inputs.landscapeHint: First image is the main subject/landscape; the rest are people/objects. Drag tiles to reorder.
inputs.h3VideoHint: Use <Video 1>, <Video 2>… in the prompt. The embedded soundtrack is paired automatically as <Audio n>. Each clip must be 2–15 seconds.
inputs.h3AudioHint: Use <Audio 1>, <Audio 2>… in the prompt. Audio-only Ref2VA is not supported: also add an image or video reference.
inputs.startMismatch: The Start image is {{width}}×{{height}} ({{sourceOrientation}}), but MiniMax H3 is set to {{targetWidth}}×{{targetHeight}} ({{targetOrientation}}).
inputs.cropHint: Edges will be cropped to fill the frame; the image will not be stretched.
inputs.containHint: It will be kept complete, centred and undistorted, with black bars {{bars}}.
inputs.compositeHint: MiniMax H3 cannot keep the exact Start frame and use separate identity references in the same generation. Create a composite image first: HocusPocus will place the references inside the opening scene and use the result as the exact first frame with FL2VA.

inputs.compositeReady: Composite ready. It replaced the Start frame; MiniMax H3 will now preserve it with FL2VA.

tools.selectGalleryImage: Select an image from the library
tools.flashvsrOff: FlashVSR is disabled in Settings → Services. Enable it, or pick a Lanczos method.

post.title: Post Processing
post.singleHint: Replaces every voice in the audio with the reference voice. Affects the whole audio track.
post.twoHint: Auto-detects 2 speakers; preserves background music & silence. First detected speaker → Voice A, second → Voice B.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.encoderReload: Changing this reloads the H3 model.
advanced.cacheHint: Reuses stable transformer work after warmup. Best suited to 15-20 step H3 runs; higher thresholds can change motion or fine detail.
advanced.planWindowsHint: H3 expands one idea into complete window-local visual and audio prompts. Enhance enables this automatically; disable afterward only to supply manual line-per-window prompts.
advanced.thresholdHint: Volume level where boosting kicks in. Lower = catches quieter parts.
advanced.attackHint: How fast the compressor reacts. Low = catches brief dips at speaker transitions.
advanced.releaseHint: How fast it returns to normal after boosting. Higher = smoother.
advanced.makeupHint: How much to boost the quiet parts. Higher = louder transitions.
advanced.fitBars: Fit with black bars · no distortion
advanced.cropFill: Crop to fill canvas · edges may be lost
advanced.fitHint: Fit preserves the complete source inside the selected canvas; black bars appear only when aspect ratios differ. Crop fills the canvas but can remove content near the edges.
advanced.singleTitle: Run at full target resolution in one pass. No upscale, no refine. Higher VRAM.
advanced.standardTitle: Half-res denoise, then 2x spatial upscale + refine. Balanced speed/quality.
advanced.singleHint: Runs the distilled denoise at full target resolution in one pass. No stage-2 upscale or refine. Uses ~4× the stage-1 VRAM of 2-Stage mode; drop to a smaller resolution preset if you OOM.
advanced.referencePipelineHint: Runs the model author's ComfyUI workflow config: 9+3 steps on hand-tuned sigmas, CFG only on the first 2 steps, STG on the first 4, ancestral sampling. Steps / CFG / STG sliders below are ignored while this is on.
advanced.turboLock: Turbo mode locks this preset to {{steps}} steps.
advanced.fastCfg: Fast keeps its distilled CFG 1 recipe; guidance and negative-prompt controls do not apply.
advanced.stgHint: Spatio-temporal guidance. 0 = off. Sharpens structure & motion via a third denoising pass (~50% slower). Try 1.0.
advanced.gradientHint: Use 20-25 steps instead of 30-40 for comparable quality.
advanced.replaceHint: Replace: exact adherence to source image. Additive: smoother blending.
advanced.injectHint: Additive: smooth transitions at injected frames. Replace: strict adherence.

omni.title: Omni References
omni.orderHint: Order matters. Picture, Video, and Audio labels are assigned from top to bottom and can be named in your prompt. Video soundtracks stay attached to their video.
omni.unsupported: {{name}} is not a supported image, video, or audio file.
omni.limit: Reference limit reached ({{image}} images, {{video}} videos, {{audio}} audio; {{total}} total).
omni.rolePlaceholder: Who or what is this? (helps Enhance)
omni.intentHint: Voice reference conditions a new voice without copying the recording. Drive/reuse follows the recording's audible timeline. Style reference borrows only musical or sound character.
omni.detailHint: Match output uses less memory and is recommended. Maximum detail follows the official 2048px-short-edge reference preparation and can require substantially more memory.

blend.insertHint: Adds new footage between clips. Total duration increases.
blend.overlapHint: Replaces the end of A and start of B with a generated transition. Total duration stays the same.
blend.overlapTrim: Trims {{seconds}}s from the end of A and start of B, generates a {{seconds}}s replacement.
blend.prefixOff: Pure start+end mode — no motion carried from Clip A
blend.prefixOn: First {{seconds}}s of blend replays Clip A's tail so rotation/pan carries through
blend.suffixOff: Single end-frame anchor — model may slow-mo into the landing
blend.suffixOn: Last {{seconds}}s of blend previews Clip B's head so motion lands at real speed
blend.anchorHint: Higher = tighter lock to Clip A/B endpoints (may crossfade). Lower = AI invents more motion between them (may drift). Start at 0.7.
blend.outputInsert: Output: Clip A + {{seconds}}s transition + Clip B
blend.outputOverlap: Output: Clip A (−{{seconds}}s) + {{seconds}}s transition + Clip B (−{{seconds}}s)
blend.needBoth: Add both clips to enable blending

editAnything.hintLead: Prompt-driven edit — no mask needed. Write one of:
editAnything.rangeHint: Optional: select a time range below to edit only part of the clip
editAnything.loraHint: Per the LoRA card: start at 1.0. Bump to 1.2 if the edit is too weak; drop below if it distorts unrelated content.
editAnything.preserveHint: How much of the source's structure is regenerated. Lower = more source preserved (subtle edit), higher = more aggressive.

outpaint.drop: Drop a video or image to outpaint
outpaint.qualityHint: Auto keeps full source resolution after padding. Pick a preset to scale down for lower-VRAM models.
outpaint.preserveSceneHint: Protects the source and softly blends the new area.
outpaint.preserveTitle: Uses LTX-2.3's binary-mask conditioning and a soft multiscale boundary blend. Disable only to compare with HocusPocus's legacy Outpaint path.
outpaint.preserveAudioHint: Re-mux the original soundtrack into the outpainted clip. The model would otherwise generate fresh audio that doesn't match the source.
outpaint.trimSmearHint: Trim the last few frames of each sliding-window segment where the model occasionally smears the boundary.

repaint.title: Repaint from first frame
repaint.aboutText:
Edit the selected first frame, then SCAIL-2 carries that look through the source motion, interaction, and camera movement.

Fast is recommended (6 steps). HQ uses the full 40-step schedule.
repaint.drop: Drop the source video or click to upload
repaint.aboutFrameText: Change anything you want while keeping the same canvas, viewpoint, and pose. This frame defines the new visual.
repaint.aboutRegionsText: Leave this empty for whole-frame Repaint. Add a source-to-edited-frame mapping only when an object or person needs an explicit color correspondence.
repaint.mismatch: One or more descriptions did not match. Refine the highlighted fields.

recast.title: Replace characters
recast.aboutText:
Add one card for each person you want to replace. HocusPocus isolates references, adds a face-detail view when useful, and preserves detected bystanders automatically.

Fast is recommended (8 steps). HQ uses the full 40-step schedule.
recast.aboutMappingsText: Each card links one source person to one replacement. Its color stays fixed across all reference views so targets cannot swap.
recast.previewTitle: Scan the selected timeline and preview each character anchor
recast.notFound: Not found in the selected timeline.
recast.aboutViewsText: Optional close-up, side, or back views of this same character. Multi-reference is experimental; add only views that reveal details missing from the main image.
recast.aboutPreparedText: These are the identity, spatial-reference, and semantic-mask inputs that will be sent to SCAIL-2.
recast.aboutSourceText: HocusPocus scans the selected timeline. Each tile shows one character card at its strongest detected anchor; the same color remains assigned across shots.
recast.foundSome: Found {{matched}} of {{requested}}. Refine the highlighted card description or adjust the selected range.
recast.previewFailedLog: Preview failed — check the server log.
recast.aboutLightingText: Uses Z.ai's official SCAIL-2 Relighting LoRA to blend lighting and shadows. It may affect nearby people in crowded shots. Select the same LoRA in Advanced to expose its single strength control.

inpaint.installHint: Open the Pinokio menu and click 'Install Inpaint Support (SAM 3.1)' to enable inpainting. ~5 min one-time setup.
inpaint.samRecover: Check SAM installation or run Preview Mask to start it on demand.
inpaint.dropHint: Describe what to change — AI segments and replaces
inpaint.promptHint: CFG — how hard the model follows your prompt inside the masked region. 1.0 ≈ prompt ignored (output looks like original). 3–4 ≈ balanced. 5+ ≈ strong, may distort.
inpaint.retakeHint: How aggressively the masked region is re-generated. 0.1–0.4 = subtle tweak, keeps source look. 0.7–0.9 = full replacement with prompt content.
inpaint.footer: Preview Mask checks targeting. Use the prompt below for what to generate, then click Generate.
